setup.text: Ilsa sets a bundle of sticks into the forge mouth, settling them into the ash. She steps back a half-pace.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "How do you get it going?"

Ilsa steps back a half-pace. "You clear back first. Always."

option_b.text: The player tries the same clearing motion on a second stick, off to the side. It catches, small and steady.

option_c.text: The player picks up a river stone lying nearby and holds it near the coals. The light catches the edge of the rock, but the stone remains cold.
